findings.resolution: The same datasheet the approved wahapedia:000002770 resolution already covers, re-identified under html mode where a detail id is the page anchor rather than an export id: an Epic Hero INFANTRY character in the knightly faction, no unit-cost table on its card, and no points entry on a faction page that leaves no unmatched unit at all. Carried forward unchanged in reasoning.

A chapter-specific named character datacard that prints no unit-cost table, and which the points source does not carry at all -- it also raises REC-UNMATCHED-DETAIL-ONLY, so no unmatched points entry exists that a rename could be argued from. No source prices it. Excluded rather than shipped at zero; the digest lapses the moment either source prices it.
